title:
Resolves arguments into a single {@link DataPrepPreviewChartSpec} and triggers data request for the
`Reliability.AssetDataPreparationPreviewChart`dynamic component.

Triggered by `FILTER_SUBMIT` action.

Payload takes the following arguments:
 * `value`: Inherited from `FILTER_SUBMIT` action with filter arguments for:
   * `sensors`
   * `trainingMaskOptions`
   * `inferenceMaskOptions`
   * `showAllSensorData`
   * `interval`
 * `dynamicComponentDataSourceId`: The chart dynamic component to trigger a data request for.
 * `stateId`: The application state which includes the user-selected time window.
name: DataPreparationUpdatePreviewChartEpic
